# .

> Sourdough makes a new Wayne State app with the stack already wired in: SESAME sign-in, HELMET runtime baseline, PROCTOR checks, WayneUI and a Citadel release script. One PHP command, every operating system.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [Sourdough: Feed it and it grows.](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): Sourdough makes a new Wayne State app with the stack already wired in: SESAME sign-in, HELMET runtime baseline, PROCTOR checks, WayneUI and a Citadel release script. One PHP command, every operating system.

## Prompts

- [Get started with Sourdough](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): Install the starter, bake a raw PHP app, fetch WayneUI, serve it, and check the label on the jar. The prompt itself is in https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Check what has drifted in a Sourdough app](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-manifest): Read the manifest, list the managed files that changed, and propose what to put back, before anything is fed. The prompt itself is in https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/waynestate/sourdough/blob/HEAD/README.md): the project's README, with install, commands and checks
- [Everything in one file](https://sourdough.apps.wayne.edu/llms-full.txt): the README and every page above, as one Markdown file
